pr_title: GLES3: Ensure all ShaderData is properly initialized in `set_code`
pr_body:
- Fixes #84418 (at least it should, didn't test yet as this needs an optimized build).
- Supersedes #84599.

I refactored the code to be clearer and hopefully prevent such errors in the future, but it's still quite error prone. The config booleans could maybe be moved to an internal struct that would always be zero'ed in `set_code`, so this can all be done in a single line instead of listing them all one by one.

I noticed that `version` doesn't get reset when calling `set_code`; I suppose this is intended.

Some ShaderData implementations initialized most of their booleans before the early return with empty `code`, while others did them after declaring `gen_code`. I unified to be like the former which seems to be the least bug prone (doesn't assume that none of these will be accessed when `valid = false`), but I could refactor the other way around if preferred.

issue_context.title: Warning spam in Compatibility renderer: Attempting to use a shader that requires tangents with a mesh that doesn't contain tangents.
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

Godot v4.2.beta (5ee983188)

### System information

 - Windows 10.0.22621 - GLES3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.3699) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700F (20 Threads)

### Issue description

When create a new scene and add any mesh instance 3d to it, the following warning spams: 
```
drivers\gles3\rasterizer_scene_gles3.cpp:265 - Attempting to use a shader that requires tangents with a mesh that doesn't contain tangents. Ensure that meshes are imported with the 'ensure_tangents' option. If creating your own meshes, add an `ARRAY_TANGENT` array (when using ArrayMesh) or call `generate_tangents()` (when using SurfaceTool). (User)
```

This doen't happen in forward plus or mobile.

![image](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/8315986/90e7b434-9ccc-4682-a0a5-cd4f417a5db0)


### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new project with Compatibility renderer
2. create a new scene and add a mesh instance 3d to it
3. observe the warning spam

### Minimal reproduction project

N/A
comments: Just start an empty project in Compatibility mode in 4.2 Beta and this happens immediately without adding any meshes.

This warning appears to have been introduced by this commit:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/d1043a5f930513aa4b48b014ec7961cad48b0560

We uses the `uses_tangent` variable to track whether the shader uses tangents or not. The variable is set to `true` if certain shader built ins are used here: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/3e7f638d7b574785f521beafaf52a6ad95be016f/drivers/gles3/storage/material_storage.cpp#L2925-L2928

However, mistakenly `uses_tangent` isn't initialized above (and a few others). So if it's not set to `true` it's used uninitialized and can be anything. 

I'll bet that is what's causing this issue and the solution is to initialize it to false above with all the other variables.
I will take a look, thanks!
Confirmed with 4.2-beta5 official build. Can't reproduce with a local dev build of the master branch, probably because GCC initializes memory differently for unoptimized builds.
